fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 4% of Gross Sales for the first year (until first anniversary), then 6% of Gross Sales for the remainder of the franchise agreement term. National Advertising Fund currently required at 1% of monthly Gross Sales, may be increased up to 2%. Local advertising cooperative up to $500/month; local advertising expenditures minimum $1,000/month. E-mail exchange mailbox fee $15/month per mailbox. Gift Card Transactions ACH Monthly Settlement Service Fee of $10/month per bank account. Lease payments (if subleased from franchisor) $3,000-$10,000/month. Lease Guaranty Fee equal to the amount by which 16% of monthly Gross Revenues exceeds monthly lease payments. Transfer fee $100 (legal entity) or $5,000 (third party). Renewal fee $2,500. Late fee 1.5%/month plus $100 administrative fee.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | 4% of Gross Sales until first year anniversary; From first year anniversary through end of Franchise Agreement term: 6% of Gross Sales | Payable by "EFT" monthly and withdrawn by the 15th of the next month.
National Advertising Fund (the "National Fund") | Up to 2% of Gross Sales (currently required to pay 1%) | Same time as Royalty Fee.
Local advertising cooperative | Up to $500 per month, as approved by Co-op | As established by members of the Cooperative.
Local Advertising Expenditures | Minimum of $1,000 per month | As incurred.
E-mail Exchange Mailbox | $15 per month per mailbox | As incurred.
Gift Card Transactions ACH Monthly Settlement | Service Fees of $10/month per Bank Account | The 6th (Sixth) of each month or next business day.
Lease payments | $3,000 - $10,000 per month | Monthly at least 10 days before due date.
Lease Renewal Fee | $1,500 | Immediately upon execution of the lease renewal.
Lease Guaranty Fee | The amount by which sixteen percent (16%) of your monthly Gross Revenues exceed your monthly lease payments | Monthly.
Transfer – legal entity | $100 | Before transfer.
Transfer Fee – 3rd party | $5,000 per Shop | Before transfer.
Franchise Renewal Fee | $2,500 per Shop | When you reacquire the franchise.
Interest on Overdue Payments & Late Fees | 1.5% per month or highest commercial contract interest rate, whichever is less, plus $100 administrative fee; $100 late fee for failure to submit report of gross revenues | On demand after payments become overdue.
Additional Training Fee | Then-current tuition fee $100 per day plus expenses and costs of training materials and supplies | Prior to receiving additional training.
Annual Convention | Up to $1,000 per person attending | Registration fee due upon registration.
Franchisor-Obtained Insurance | Out-of-pocket cost reimbursement | On demand by Franchisor.
Indemnification | Varies | On demand.
Supplier Testing | Reasonable cost of inspection and actual costs of test(s) | As incurred.
Ongoing Supplies/Inventory Purchases | Cost of requested inventory/supplies | Prior to delivery.
Tax Reimbursement | Reimbursement of our tax payments | When billed.
